title: Zephyrine and the Cipher
author: Silas Blackwood
blurb: Isandro Yarrow, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
